WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.tradekind, s1.cnt, s1.cnt * 1.0 / s2.total_cnt as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.tradekind, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.avg_cnt as cnt_minus_avg
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
  AND s3.cnt > s4.avg_cnt
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt) as total_step5_second_col,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_step5_third_col,
  AVG(cnt_minus_avg) as avg_step5_fourth_col
FROM step5
